summary: Red-phase tests-only run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Two permanent test suites were committed: OpenAPISpecVendoringTests pins the vendoring contract (package wiring, vendored spec at iOS/OpenAPI/color-matching.json, upstream operationIds, and every contract delta discovered between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec from viamin/color_matching#110) and GeneratedClientTests exercises the future generated client against local URLProtocol-stubbed responses, guarded by #if canImport(ColorMatchingOpenAPI) with a failing canary while the module is absent. All new tests fail by design at this head; they define the contract for the implementation run. The contract delta analysis and endpoint gaps are recorded in docs/openapi-client-migration.md to be embedded verbatim in the PR description. No Swift toolchain exists in this container (Linux, SwiftUI app target), so swift test could not be executed locally; existing tests are untouched and the suite still compiles (new generated-client code is compiled out by canImport until the module exists).
